system.description: Action, spend (SL × 4) MP. Make a DEX + INS check. On success, execute a combination attack with one of the following effects (chosen before rolling): Finishing Blow (extra damage ×2); Fleet-Foot (attack + reposition without triggering reactions); Sweeping Strike (hits up to three targets in reach); Shoulder-Shaker (inflict Dazed); The Clinch (grapple — target cannot leave the scene until the end of the round).
